about: The offertorium of the formulary “3rd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May all who know Your name hope in You, Lord, for You do not abandon those who seek You. Sing praise to the Lord enthroned in Sion, for He has not forgotten the cry of the afflicted.

ex.w001: A jussive subjunctive: all who know the Lord’s name are asked to hope in Him. The subject omnes follows the verb in Latin.
